schema_note: Each entry follows docs/mvp/templates/skill-authoring/trigger-queries.json (id, query, should_trigger, split) plus a category field. Tier A only: these observe whether the terminal consults this skill for a request that does not name it. No entry supplies the skill path or name except the explicit_invocation category, which is recorded separately and is never counted as implicit activation evidence.
split_policy: Fixed and stratified by should_trigger and category, assigned once at authoring time and recorded here. It is not re-randomised per run. Validation entries and their should_trigger values must not be placed in an author-loop or task-worker context; only the train split may drive any description iteration.
runner_dependency: Executing these queries requires the evaluation harness supplied by the Claude devforge-evaluate-expert package, which is not present at this revision. No query below has been run; every outcome is NOT_RUN.
negative_note: A negative query passes only on a successful terminal result with no consultation of this skill. A timeout, error, truncated stream or premature EOF is COULD_NOT_RUN. Observing a different skill being selected during an incomplete run does not complete the negative assertion.
